#### Drawing an envelope

Can you draw @fig-envelope without lifting your pencil from the paper and without drawing any line twice?

::: {#fig-envelope}

![](../images/graphs-envelope.png){fig-alt="Five points: v at the bottom left, w at the bottom right, x at the top left, y at the top right, and z above them in the middle.
Lines join v to w, v to x, w to y and x to y, forming a square, plus the two diagonals v to y and w to x, and the roof lines x to z and y to z." width="30%"}

An envelope: a square with both diagonals and a roof.
